name: EPSS (FIRST)
tagline: Industry-standard exploit-prediction scores for CVE prioritization
description: EPSS (Exploit Prediction Scoring System) from FIRST provides probabilistic scores estimating the likelihood that a software vulnerability will be exploited in the wild. The public API returns current and historical EPSS scores and percentiles for CVE identifiers, enabling vulnerability management tools to prioritize remediation based on real-world exploit probability rather than severity alone.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public REST endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; no paid plans published. Rate limits apply (see rate_limits).

use_cases: get current EPSS score and percentile for a CVE
batch-fetch EPSS scores for a list of CVEs
retrieve historical EPSS scores for a vulnerability over time
filter CVEs above a minimum EPSS threshold for prioritization
enrich vulnerability scan results with exploit-prediction scores
